## Package status

`form.tools` is a skeleton for neutral, model-driven workbook operations.
It does not yet export workbook functions.

## Planned workflow

The caller supplies a form model, a structurally valid source workbook, and a matching empty template.
Primary-key and parent-key checks must also pass before splitting.

The splitter will select records for each root key and populate a separate workbook using the template.
Shared-sheet copying and output naming remain explicit design decisions.

Domain packages supply their own form definitions and templates.
